_about: Hand-kept dates for the homepage This Week calendar (calendar_events.py). India data releases, policy dates and the main global events (US Fed decision, US CPI). kind: india | policy | market | global. big: true only for India CPI, GDP, RBI policy, Budget. time: IST 24h or null. confirmed: false = worked out from the agency's usual rule, shown as 'expected'. Market dates (F&O expiry, holidays, results deadline) and forex reserves are added by rule in code. Researched 11 Nov 2026 from MoSPI's ARC 2026-27, OEA/DPIIT ARCs, S&P Global's PMI calendar, RBI's MPC schedule 2026-27, the Fed's FOMC calendar and BLS's CPI schedule. Extend before April 2027.
